websites.title: A website you see finished before you pay.
websites.lead: Modern, fast and mobile-first websites for businesses. You approve the result, then pay and receive the site together with its full source code.
websites.reasonsTitle: Why a business needs its own website

reasons.d: Clients often check a company online before they call. A clear site answers their first questions.
Search engines can show your pages to people who look for your services, not only to your followers.
Algorithm changes, blocked accounts or a platform losing popularity do not take your website away.
Language versions, correct metadata and fast loading make your business accessible to clients abroad.
Services, terms, contacts, location and answers to common questions, in a structure you control.
Your ads, social profiles and business cards can all point to one address that you own.

process.d: We study your business, audience and visual style, or you send us a brief.
We build the site and share a preview link clearly marked as a demo.
You send changes. We implement agreed revisions within the rounds of your package.
Payment after final approval, before handover and launch.
You receive the clean site without demo marks, and its source code.

faq.q: Do I have to pay before I see the website?
faq.a: No. You see the site first. Payment is due after you approve the final version and before we hand over the source code and launch the site on your infrastructure.

faq.q: Is the preview my official website?
faq.a: No. A preview is a commercial proposal from SpectrTech, clearly marked as a demo. It becomes your site only after approval and payment.
No, unless agreed separately. You pay the providers directly; the actual amount depends on the providers you choose.

faq.q: Is there a subscription or mandatory support?
faq.a: No. You pay once for the agreed work. Further changes can be discussed as a separate project.

faq.q: Can I edit the website myself?
faq.a: The site is delivered without a built-in editor. You receive clean source code that you or any developer can change.
Yes. Languages are agreed in the brief, and each version gets its own address and metadata.

sections.p: This notice explains what happens to the information you send through the SpectrTech website at spectrtech.si.
The form collects your name, email and the details you choose to write. We use them only to answer your request and to prepare a proposal. We do not sell or share them for advertising.
If you write to us by email or Telegram, your message is processed by those services under their own terms.
This site counts visits with GoatCounter, a privacy-friendly analytics service that does not use cookies for tracking.
You can ask us to delete the details you sent by writing to spectrtech@protonmail.com.
Our apps have their own privacy information on their pages, for example the Coin Drop Tycoon privacy policy.
